entries.guide.tpl.tips.intro: Dore ibitekerezo ku bice ukwiye kwitaho mbere.
entries.guide.tpl.tips.none: Ibice byose wasubije biri mu rugero rwiza. Iyi myitwarire igufasha kugumana uru rugero.
entries.ga.tobacco.no_reported_risk.why: Kudakoresha itabi birinda umutima wawe, ibihaha n'umuvuduko w'amaraso.
entries.ga.tobacco.no_reported_risk.tips: Komeza utyo, kandi wirinde umwotsi w'itabi ry'abandi aho bishoboka.
entries.ga.tobacco.attention.why: Itabi mu buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose ryongera ibyago by'indwara z'umutima, stroke, indwara z'ibihaha na kanseri zimwe. Ibyiza byo kurireka bitangira mu byumweru bike.
entries.ga.tobacco.attention.tips: Niba ushaka kurigabanya cyangwa kurireka, hitamo umunsi wo gutangira, ubibwire umuntu wizeye, kandi ubaze ku kigo nderabuzima ubufasha bwo kurireka. Buri gihe uhisemo kudakoresha itabi biragufasha.
entries.ga.alcohol.lower_risk.why: Kunywa inzoga nke cyangwa kutazinywa bifasha umwijima, umuvuduko w'amaraso n'ibitotsi.
entries.ga.alcohol.lower_risk.tips: Niba unywa, bigire gake, urye igihe unywa, kandi unywe amazi hagati.
entries.ga.alcohol.attention.why: Kunywa kenshi, cyangwa kunywa nyinshi icyarimwe, byongera umuvuduko w'amaraso n'ibyago by'indwara z'umwijima, impanuka na kanseri zimwe.
entries.ga.alcohol.attention.tips: Gerageza iminsi mike mu cyumweru utanywa inzoga, hitamo ibinyobwa bito, kandi uhinduranye inzoga n'amazi cyangwa umutobe. Umukozi w'ubuzima ashobora kubiganiraho nawe, nta guca urubanza.
entries.ga.activity.meets.why: Gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri buri gihe bikomeza umutima, bifasha ku biro no ku muvuduko w'amaraso, kandi bikongera imbaraga.
entries.ga.activity.meets.tips: Komeza utyo. Kugenda n'amaguru, siporo, kubyina n'imirimo igukoresha umubiri byose birabarwa.
entries.ga.activity.below.why: Gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri buri gihe bikomeza umutima, bifasha ku biro no ku muvuduko w'amaraso, kandi bikongera imbaraga.
entries.ga.activity.below.tips: Igihe gito nacyo kirabarwa. Kugenda vuba iminota icumi, kuzamuka amadarajya, kugenda n'amaguru igice cy'urugendo aho gutega moto, cyangwa kubyina indirimbo nke byose biriyongeranya.
entries.ga.diet.meets.why: Imbuto n'imboga biha umubiri wawe fibre, vitamini n'imyunyu ngugu birinda umutima.
entries.ga.diet.meets.tips: Komeza ubyongere kuri buri funguro. Imbuto n'imboga byo mu gihugu byera muri icyo gihe akenshi ni byo bihendutse.
entries.ga.diet.below.why: Imbuto n'imboga biha umubiri wawe fibre, vitamini n'imyunyu ngugu birinda umutima.
entries.ga.diet.below.tips: Ongeraho ingano imwe buri gihe: umuneke cyangwa avoka ku ifunguro rya mu gitondo, dodo, isombe cyangwa shu ku ifunguro rya saa sita, cyangwa urubuto nk'icyo kurya hagati.
entries.ga.bmi.underweight.why: Kuba munsi y'urugero rwiza bishobora gusobanura ko umubiri wawe utabona imbaraga n'intungamubiri bihagije.
entries.ga.bmi.underweight.tips: Kurya buri gihe ibishyimbo, amagi, amata, ubunyobwa cyangwa amafi bishobora gufasha. Niba waratakaje ibiro utabishaka, ni byiza kubonana n'umukozi w'ubuzima.
entries.ga.bmi.normal.why: Ibiro biri mu rugero rwiza bigabanya ibyago by'umuvuduko w'amaraso uri hejuru na diyabete.
entries.ga.bmi.normal.tips: Imyitozo ngororamubiri ihoraho n'amafunguro yuzuye bigufasha kuguma aha.
entries.ga.bmi.overweight.why: Ibiro biri hejuru y'urugero rwiza byongera ibyago by'umuvuduko w'amaraso uri hejuru, diyabete n'ububabare bw'ingingo uko igihe kigenda.
entries.ga.bmi.overweight.tips: Ita ku myitwarire aho gutakaza ibiro vuba: imboga nyinshi, ibinyobwa birimo isukari n'ibikaranze bike, n'imyitozo mike yiyongera buri munsi.
entries.ga.bmi.obesity.why: Ibiro biri hejuru cyane y'urugero rwiza byongera ibyago by'umuvuduko w'amaraso uri hejuru, diyabete n'indwara z'umutima.
entries.ga.bmi.obesity.tips: Impinduka nto kandi zihoraho mu myitwarire ni zo zikora neza. Umukozi w'ubuzima ashobora gupima umuvuduko w'amaraso n'isukari mu maraso akagufasha gutegura.
entries.ga.waist.not_increased.why: Ingano y'umukondo wawe iri mu rugero rufitanye isano n'ibyago bike bya diyabete n'indwara z'umutima.
entries.ga.waist.not_increased.tips: Imyitozo ngororamubiri n'amafunguro yuzuye bifasha kubigumana bityo.
entries.ga.waist.increased.why: Ibinure bibitse ku nda bifitanye isano n'ibyago byinshi bya diyabete n'indwara z'umutima.
entries.ga.waist.increased.tips: Kunyeganyega buri munsi no kunywa ibinyobwa birimo isukari no kurya ibikaranze bike bifasha kubigabanya.
entries.ga.waist.substantially_increased.why: Umukondo munini cyane ufitanye isano n'ibyago byinshi bigaragara bya diyabete n'indwara z'umutima.
entries.ga.waist.substantially_increased.tips: Impinduka zihoraho mu myitwarire zirafasha, kandi umukozi w'ubuzima ashobora gupima isukari mu maraso n'umuvuduko w'amaraso.
entries.ga.bp.normal.why: Umuvuduko w'amaraso uri ku rugero rusanzwe ntuvunisha cyane umutima n'imitsi y'amaraso.
entries.ga.bp.normal.tips: Komeza gukora imyitozo, ugabanye umunyu, kandi wongere kuwupimisha rimwe na rimwe.
entries.ga.bp.high_normal.why: Umuvuduko w'amaraso uri hejuru gato y'urugero rusanzwe ushobora kwiyongera uko igihe kigenda, akenshi nta bimenyetso.
entries.ga.bp.high_normal.tips: Umunyu muke, imbuto n'imboga byinshi, imyitozo ihoraho n'inzoga nke byose birafasha. Ongera uwupimishe ubutaha ugiye ku kigo nderabuzima.
entries.ga.bp.hypertension_range.why: Igipimo kimwe ntigihagije kugira ngo tumenye, bityo igipimo kiri muri uru rugero kigomba kwemezwa.
entries.ga.bp.hypertension_range.tips: Ongera uwupimishe ku kigo nderabuzima ku wundi munsi. Kugeza icyo gihe, umunyu muke n'imyitozo ihoraho birafasha.
